messages:
tasha_sales: Heads-up: POC with a UK public-sector team. They pinned `redwood-9b-v2` and are getting `model not available in region` then occasional 429 spikes. Demo in 35m, need quick triage.
vikram_se: Can you paste the exact request and any x-request-id?
tasha_sales: Request: `POST /v1/generate {"model":"redwood-9b-v2","region":"eu-west-2"}` Tenant `uk-gov-22`. X-req `req_b7a4f1`. Errors: `{"error":"model not available in region","code":404}` and sometimes `{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":1}`.
noah_infra: Checking catalog. Quick note: hosted model replicas may not be deployed in eu-west-2 unless pinned to Dedicated or replicated. 404 likely = no replica for that model in the region.
liz_sre: I see req_b7a4f1 in router logs. Router tried to hit model endpoint in eu-west-2, catalog returned "no replica" at 11:22:13 UTC. Also saw a short burst of 429s 11:22:10-11:22:16 UTC.
vikram_se: Short-term workaround: flip tenant soft-fallback to `redwood-9b-compat-eu` or update the demo request to the compat variant. Example patch: `{"model":"redwood-9b-compat-eu"}`
harper_security: Customer asks two things: 1) KMS key residency in UK (must remain in-country) and 2) allowlisting our Dedicated pool IPs. Confirmed?
noah_infra: For Dedicated/Private we support UK BYOK/KMS and CIDR allowlists. For hosted, BYOK in UK KMS is possible under enterprise contract but true regional pinning requires Dedicated.
billing-bot: Note: Dedicated regional pin + reserved capacity often requires a minimum annual commit. Contact accounts for a tailored quote.
vikram_se: For the demo I can enable soft-fallback on their tenant and request a temporary quota bump to reduce demo-time 429s. Will that work?
tasha_sales: Please do. Also they'll want a written note for the questionnaire re: KMS and IP allowlist.
liz_sre: Done: soft-fallback enabled -> compat model. Applied a temporary quota increase (+25 concurrency) for 72h to tenant `uk-gov-22`. Documented in ticket POC-UK-9087.
noah_infra: Long-term: propose Dedicated with pinned replica deployed to eu-west-2 and a baseline reserved throughput; we'll pre-warm KV caches and autoscale policies.
harper_security: I'll draft an answer for the security questionnaire covering KMS BYOK options, key residency, audit logs, and IP allowlisting for Dedicated. tasha, send me their questionnaire items.
tasha_sales: Sending now. Also cc'ing accounts to start a ballpark estimate for regional pin + capacity.
billing-bot: Action: created sales-opportunity SO-4882; accounts to follow up with quote.
vikram_se: Marking this thread resolved for now. Ping if 429s reoccur after the quota bump. :thumbsup:
